items.title: Khao Sok National Park
items.subtitle: 4.7 ( 8.8k ) ‧ National park in Thailand
items.description: Khao Sok National Park is a nature reserve in southern Thailand containing dense virgin jungle, towerlike limestone karst formations and the man-made Cheow Lan Lake. It’s home to rare species such as the giant parasitic Rafflesia flower, hornbill birds, gibbons and tigers. The park can be explored by elephant-back safari, hiking trail, and raft, canoe or kayak via the Sok river. ― Google

expanded_element.description: Species of Bears Found in Khao Sok National Park: The bear species found in Khao Sok National Park and around Cheow Lan Lake is the Malayan Sun Bear (Helarctos malayanus), the smallest bear species in the world.

expanded_element.title: Khao Sok Travel Guide - How many days to stay in Khao Sok?
expanded_element.description: You will need at least 2 days to enjoy the incredible nature and variety of activities available. Most visitors choose to stay 1 night near the entrance to the park, before staying on Cheow Lan Lake. Staying in the jungle is a perfect introduction to the nature and wildlife of the area.
